English: Open Table
A basic communal table set up under the sky, where traders and locals meet to barter wares and news. The humble beginnings of a nomadic marketplace.
Barter Patch
A rough patch of ground marked for bartering, with mats and simple coverings providing shade. Local produce and goods are exchanged freely, growing clan interdependence.
Traders Tent
A sturdy canvas tent raised for merchants and traders to shelter their wares and negotiate with travelers, attracting distant caravans and growing the local economy.
Merchants Pavilion
A grand pavilion of colored cloth, supported by wooden frames, serving as a trading center for precious goods, with guarded storage and bustling trade.
Market Stand
Wooden stalls lined up in orderly rows, each hosting a merchants goods. The market stand draws more traders and increases the prosperity of the nomad camp.
Exchange Room
A semi-permanent wooden structure with an enclosed room for major transactions, record-keeping, and secure warehousing. Trusted by distant caravans and local chieftains alike.
Market Hall
A large, enclosed hall of timber and stone, sheltering traders and visitors from the elements. The heart of Indo-Aryan nomad commerce, supporting vibrant trade and population growth.
Guild Pavilion
A prestigious structure of carved wood and imported stone, where merchant guilds gather to decide trade policies, arbitrate disputes, and store their wealth, drawing dignitaries and artisans.
Grand Market Room

A vast chamber of commerce, with stone vaults, painted pillars, and protected vaults for storing great wealth and goods. The regions most important trading nexus, supporting population and horde growth.
Indo-Aryan Grand Market
A legendary market complex of marble, lacquered woods, and bronze, where the wealth of kingdoms is exchanged and the greatest hosts gather. A monument to Indo-Aryan prosperity and dominance.
